title: Add correlated-error-aggregator and synthetic-invocation-reporter for noise-reduced SLO signals
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Added a correlated error aggregation pipeline and a low-volume synthetic invocation reporter to improve signal-to-noise for tenant SLO alerts; new dashboards and alert hysteresis settings included; runtime hook is opt-in behind feature flag.
description:
Motivation: We see frequent short-lived, cross-tenant error spikes that trigger noisy SLO alerts. These often come from fanout edges, transient infra glitches, or misrouted retries. Existing per-invocation error counts produce high false positive rates and high paging overhead for on-call. This PR introduces two complementary observability pieces: (1) a correlated-error-aggregator that computes probabilistic co-occurrence scores across dimensions (tenant, route, model_variant, region) and emits a compact correlation metric used by alerting to prioritize coherent incidents, and (2) a synthetic-invocation-reporter that issues low-rate synthetic requests across routing surfaces to exercise fallbacks, collect reproducible traces, and validate routing/kv-prefetch health without affecting customer quota.

What this changes: - telemetry/correlated_aggregator: new service that subscribes to sampled error spans and invocation events, computes a time-decayed co-occurrence score (exponential decay window), and emits a single correlation_metric{tenant,route,model_variant,region} per minute. The score is normalized to [0,100]. - runtime/hooks/synthetic_reporter: opt-in reporter (feature-flagged) in the request mux which issues 0.01 invocations/sec per region target surface (configurable per deployment) and attaches a synthetic-tag so it is excluded from billing pipelines. When the reporter observes a non-200 or exception it buffers a compact log bundle and emits a synthetic_failure_metric and a compressed log reference to the aggregator. - alerts/alerting_rules.yaml: new alert rule "HighCorrelatedErrorScore" that triggers only when correlation_metric>40 for 3m and sustained by synthetic_failure_metric or error_rate>2% over same window; includes a two-step hysteresis: mute for 10m on single-tenant flares, escalate after cross-tenant correlation. - dashboards/observability/correlated_error_overview.json: A Grafana panel showing correlation heatmap, synthetic failure timeline, and representative sampled traces. - config/telemetry_sampling.yaml: sampling knobs exposed to ops to tune reservoir size and synthetic reporter rate.

Checklist: - [x] implement aggregator and reporter - [x] unit + integration tests for aggregator logic - [x] dashboards + alert rule - [x] feature flag gating and default off in private installs - [x] rolling rollout plan and runbook notes

Linear / Context: ENG-2123 tracks alert fatigue reduction; SRE-987 is follow-up to tune hysteresis and eviction thresholds. This PR is intentionally opt-in behind feature flag; rollout plan included in runbook.

d4b9f7e: add runtime synthetic_reporter hook and feature flag

review_comments: Liam Chen (review): Nice approach. A few asks: 1) add idempotency guard for synthetic reporter to avoid double-invocation during retries, 2) prove that correlation scores don't degenerate with sparse tenants, add unit tests for decay math.
Maya Patel (reply): Added idempotency token and expanded unit tests to include sparse tenant cases. Updated docs to call out rate limits and feature-flag default off.

Aria Gomez (request changes): Alert threshold looks aggressive for some enterprise tenants. Can we make the >40 threshold configurable per-tenant and default to 60 for long-tail customers? Also please add a short runbook snippet for manual mute.

Maya Patel (reply): Threshold is now configurable via config/alerting/tenant_thresholds.yaml and runbook appended to telemetry/README. Kept default at 40 for platform-wide detection but override allowed per-tenant.
Noah Reed (approval): Integration tests look good and CI passed on rerun. Approving to merge.
CI Bot: integration tests initially failed on flaky db-lease test; reran once and passed.
notes: Feature is behind flag feature.synthetic_reporter=false by default for hosted and private. Ops will enable in a canary region first. Runbook and tuning guide included in telemetry/README.md.
testing_notes: Integration harness includes a synthetic traffic simulator that runs in CI; local dev can toggle synthetic_reporter.rate in config/telemetry_sampling.yaml. Tests validate decay math and correlation stability across sparse tenant distribution.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: synthetic reporter could spike backend if misconfigured; mitigation: global caps at proxy-level and feature flag default off; aggregator is read-only and computes on sampled spans to limit cardinality growth.
follow_up_actions: SRE-987: tune hysteresis thresholds after 2 weeks of canary data
ENG-2191: backfill historical correlation metrics for 30d to bootstrap alerts
ENG-2200: expose correlation_metric to alerting UI for per-tenant overrides
